newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline firm with futures, U.S. beckons.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline firm with futures, U.S. beckons.

text.p: NWE gasoline was firm on Thursday as NYMEX unleaded gasoline futures showed strong price rises, traders said.
Eurograde barges were heard traded at $206 fob ARA but activity was otherwise thin as traders watched their rising screens.
Dealers said U.S. arbitrage demand would weigh in at close to a seven cent discount to October NYMEX.
This would have equated to approximately $200 a tonne for Regular barrels at around 1730 GMT, roughly equivalent to ARA barge prices, traders said.
